title: mentha × nemorosa var. morrenii
intro: Mentha × nemorosa var. morrenii, commonly known as Morrocan mint or Bergamot mint, is a hybrid plant of the mint species. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, relieve nausea and headaches, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Morrocan mint include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its potential use in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Morrocan mint include menthone, menthol, and limonene, which are responsible for its characteristic aroma and medicinal properties.
